What are some reasons as to why a computer becomes slow?

Take the side panel off and look inside. If you see a lot of dust in the fans and heatsinks, that's it. Get a can of compressed air and blow out all the dust.

It could also be too many processes running. If you have malware that's hidden, your CPU will be running constantly, which slows down the whole system.

It could also be programs requiring too many resources that you don't have. For example, it would be painful to run the latest version of Libre Office on a P2. Yes, that's an extreme example, but just because your computer is 2 years old doesn't mean much. The hardware can be older and not up to snuff for bleeding edge software.

You could also be lacking RAM.

There's really any number of possible reasons.

Having a lot of files on your OS drive is also cause for slow downs.

It's always a good idea to have a dedicated drive just for your OS and keep programs and other files on other drives to retain speed.

Is this the OS drive? http://sli.mg/GGmpTt

C drive is typically the OS drive, yes.

Yes, your OS is on the C: drive, but so is everything else you have; including games, videos, pictures, browser bookmarks, programs, apps, etc.

The idea is to separate the two: A drive dedicated to ONLY your OS, and a drive dedicated to ONLY the other stuff. This way, one doesn't slow the other down.
MS update. Reinstall Win7. Turn off updates. Good to go.

If it's a laptop with a couple years of use or more it's likely due to damaged sectors on the hard drive. This is especially true if it's been moved around a lot. You could run SeaTools to check for corrupted sectors and the general health of the drive. It could also be due to extra startup programs. You can easily find out how to disable them with a quick search.
